summary: Join our Ecosystem-Based Adaptation Strategies Training Course to master innovative techniques for adapting to climate change and protecting natural resources.
lede: Ecosystem-based adaptation uses ecosystem services to reduce climate risks and strengthen resilience. For professionals responsible for climate adaptation, this course covers assessing hazards, vulnerability and ecosystem services; designing and prioritizing interventions; preparing costed plans; and tracking ecological, social and resilience outcomes while considering community participation and safeguards.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who are at the forefront of climate adaptation efforts across various sectors. It is tailored for those who need to integrate ecosystem-based strategies into their work to enhance resilience and sustainability.
audience: Climate change and adaptation officers in government
Environmental and natural resource management professionals
Disaster risk reduction (DRR) and resilience practitioners
Water resources, rangeland, forestry, and coastal management
Sustainability, ESG, and climate risk professionals
modules: Climate Risk, Vulnerability, and Exposure Assessment
EbA Planning at Landscape and Community Levels
EbA Value for Money and Prioritization
Social Inclusion and Safeguards in EbA
EbA Financing and Climate Fund Readiness
Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning for EbA Results
EbA Implementation Management and Operational Planning
Communicating EbA for Buy-In and Decision Support
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of climate change and adaptation principles. Experience in project management or environmental science is beneficial but not mandatory.
